propositions: A committed lock file freezes transitive dependencies, causing any future advisory published against a pinned version to block CI on all in-flight changes regardless of code authorship.

The gating pip-audit job cannot distinguish between reachable and unreachable dependencies in the environment, so an advisory on an extra-only capping dependency (e.g. inspect-ai holding click) blocks the base runtime scan.
The job's retry logic only retries DB-unreachable failures, making a real advisory finding non-recheckable and causing authors to diagnose issues they did not introduce.
Constraint-dependencies can only narrow an existing set and return UNSATISFIABLE as expected output; override-dependencies is the correct instrument for capping an upstream incompatibility.
Override-dependencies are workspace-local directives not published in wheel metadata, affecting only the repository's lock and not downstream consumers.
Stale overrides must be detected via periodic review rather than relying on manual re-testing, following the established pattern of scheduled drift detection in the repo.
